sunnahs.quote: Jangan memandang remeh apa-apa kebaikan, walaupun bertemu saudaramu dengan wajah yang ceria.
Allah menyukai kelembutan dalam setiap urusan.
Sesiapa yang tidak mengasihi, tidak akan dikasihi.
Pause before an ordinary task and consider the good you intend. The hadith connects deeds with intentions.
Choose a manageable good deed and return to it regularly. The hadith values consistency even in small deeds.
Mention Allah’s name, eat with your right hand, and take what is nearest to you in a shared dish.
Let your words bring good. When there is nothing good to say, silence can help prevent harmful speech.
The hadith connects faith with avoiding harm to neighbours and treating guests generously.
Make ablution before bed and lie on your right side. Both actions appear in the Prophet’s guidance.
Do not postpone charity just because you can give only a little. The hadith mentions even half a date.
Share the greeting of peace. The hadith describes salam as a way to strengthen love among believers.
Helping someone through difficulty is a meaningful good deed. The hadith encourages support and easing hardship.
Seeking beneficial knowledge is worth the effort. Read thoughtfully, check sources, and ask a knowledgeable person about what is unclear.
Gentleness makes actions better. Try expressing the same idea calmly, without harshness or humiliation.
Alhamdulillah expresses praise of Allah. The hadith describes the significance of these words, remembrance, prayer and patience.

assistant.title: Panduan Islam
assistant.disclaimer: Ini bantuan rujukan, bukan pengganti ulama atau imam.
assistant.greeting: Assalamu alaikum. Saya memberi panduan rujukan yang berhati-hati daripada al-Quran dan hadis sahih, tanpa fatwa. Bagaimana saya boleh membantu?
assistant.footnote: Untuk perkara peribadi atau khilaf, sila berbincang dengan imam tempatan yang berilmu.

stories.title: Kisah anda
stories.intro: Tempat tenang untuk perjalanan kepada Islam, kesyukuran dan pelajaran yang mungkin membantu orang lain.
stories.serverUnavailable: Kisah memerlukan pelayan Nur yang disertakan. Jalankan pelayan dan buka aplikasi melalui localhost atau HTTPS.
stories.notice: Jangan masukkan nombor telefon, alamat, dokumen atau data peribadi sensitif.
stories.formIntro: Kisah anda kekal peribadi sehingga dihantar dan diluluskan moderator.
stories.author: Nama atau nama samaran
stories.consent: Saya faham kisah ini dihantar kepada moderator untuk semakan dan tidak boleh mengandungi maklumat peribadi sensitif.
stories.formInvalid: Isi nama, tajuk, sekurang-kurangnya 20 aksara dan sahkan notis privasi.
stories.sent: Terima kasih. Kisah dihantar untuk moderasi.
